text: In 2015 residents around the Hogarth Avenue and Ingham Avenue intersection requested a report on measures that would reduce traffic infiltration, speed, and other measures to improve pedestrian safety in this neighbourhood. In a review of past TEYCC motions my office determined that this request had never been completed. I am asking for your support to have Transportation report back on this request.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services to report back to the October 14, 2021 Toronto and East York Community Council meeting on Item TE4.72 (adopted at the February 18, 2015 Toronto and East York Community Council meeting).
